name: HTTP Request Pattern
description: Make HTTP API calls with Single or Multi-URL mode and optional Preset
explanation:
Pattern for making HTTP API calls.

Modes:
- Single URL: One endpoint per node (method + url)
- Multi-URL: Multiple endpoints in one node (baseUrl + requests[])

Auth types:
- none: No authentication
- apiKey: Custom header (e.g., Authorization: YOUR_KEY)
- bearer: Authorization: Bearer <token>
- basic: Base64 encoded username:password

Presets:
- direct: Manual URL input (default)
- trading212: Trading 212 API (5 endpoints)

Multi-URL mode:
- baseUrl: Base URL for all requests
- environment: demo/live switching
- requests[]: Array of { alias, method, path, enabled }
- requestDelay: Rate limit delay between requests (ms)

Result stored in:
- Single: context.httpResult (status, data, rawBody, duration)
- Multi: context.httpResult.{alias} (each with status, data, rawBody, duration)

Template variables supported in URL, headers, body:
- {{context.xxx}}: Context variables
- {{message}}: User message
- {{httpResult.xxx}}: Previous HTTP result

Credentials: Encrypted storage via WorkflowConnection (Save Credentials button).
